tools.name: youtube_trending
tools.description: Fetch currently trending YouTube videos by 2-letter ISO country code and category.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "youtube_transcript" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
